verdict.rationale: Pendo documents a self-serve API endpoint for bulk-deleting accounts and visitors without contacting support, which covers the deletion half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows configurable retention periods or retention policies. Session-replay masking is a related privacy control and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: configurable data retention controls/periods, deletion scope beyond accounts/visitors (e.g. event or replay data), UI-based deletion, independent corroboration.
